problems.summary: Alert rules with unit tests, and a check that a real failure really pages.

problems.summary: A weekly report of idle AWS resources and what they cost. It only reads and never deletes.

problems.title: Secrets end up in commits
problems.summary: Catch a leaked key before it reaches main, and know what to do when one gets through.
done_when: A secret scanner runs on every pull request and blocks the merge when it finds something.
The same scan runs on my machine as a pre-commit hook, so most leaks never leave the laptop.
A test shows that a fake key is caught and a harmless file passes.
The README says what to do when a real key leaks: revoke it first, clean up second.
The write-up shows what the scanner flagged by mistake and how I handled the false alarms.

problems.title: Terraform drifts from reality
problems.summary: A scheduled plan that notices when someone changes things by hand.
done_when: Terraform manages something small that runs locally, so the whole project costs nothing.
A scheduled workflow runs `terraform plan -detailed-exitcode` and opens a GitHub issue with the plan output when it finds a difference.
CI proves the detection: it changes the resource by hand on purpose and checks that the workflow notices.
The write-up explains the two ways to fix drift, apply the code or import the change, and when to pick which.

problems.title: The pipeline takes too long
problems.summary: Measure a slow pipeline, speed it up, and report the real before and after.
done_when: The baseline run time comes from real workflow runs, not from a guess.
Dependency and Docker layer caching are added, and parallel jobs where the steps don't depend on each other.
The write-up shows before and after times from real runs.
It also lists what I tried that didn't help.
